$comment: What the study keeps, and in what shape. `pharo-agent-telemetry generate` writes, from this file and catalog.json (the tools and words `pharo-agent-telemetry catalog` reads in the projects' source, and the classes MCP names an exception by in an image of each Pharo version), the filter `join` installs on a participant's machine (telemetry-transform.mjs), the collector's configuration (collector/otelcol.yaml), which applies the same rules again, and docs/participants.md; `pharo-agent-telemetry check` fails when any is out of date. A span is kept only from the services listed, with their scope, one of their span names, and the kinds and attributes a service `requires`. Every attribute not listed is dropped; a listed one is kept only from the services in `from` (both when absent), with the type given, and only when its value has the shape given (and, with `words`, is made of `vocabulary` words in that form: a name, or a JSON pointer of names), else it is dropped, or replaced by `otherwise`; a list with an element of another shape is dropped, but for `published`, whose elements not in a `published` set become `otherwise`. `extract` keeps the first group of a pattern, per service; `when` keeps a resource attribute only beside another's value; `beside` keeps an attribute only beside another that holds a value of its set, not its `otherwise`. `name` marks a name of the tool called: dropped (or replaced by `nameOther`) on a pharo-mcp span whose origin is other for a tool no project publishes, and on a plexus span unless it is for one of PLexus's own tools it did not forward. `own` marks what MCP says only of its own answer: dropped on a pharo-mcp span whose origin is other, for a tool no project publishes. `tool` marks the tool's name: kept when a project publishes it; else, on a pharo-mcp span whose origin is mcp or unknown, when it is made of vocabulary words; else `otherwise`. `grows` names the sets that grow with the projects' releases, by the shape of their members (a tool's name, a word, a code, a class): the only sets a signed catalog the agents fetch may add to.

process.runtime.version.about: Node's major version, or Pharo's major and minor.

deployment.environment.name.about: field for participants, eval for evaluation runs, preview while previewing, check for pharo-agent-telemetry check-deployment.

pharo_agent_evals.variant.about: Which variant of an evaluation run sent the span: the build under test, which may report a released version. Kept only for eval.

session.id.about: Groups the calls of one working session. PLexus makes it at random, or MCP when the call came without one, and either starts another after 30 minutes without a call; it is replaced by its keyed hash before it leaves your machine.

mcp.protocol.version.about: The MCP protocol version the client's request declared, a date.

gen_ai.tool.name.about: The tool's name: one a project publishes, else a name the agent asked for that no tool has, or MCP's own, when made of words of the vocabulary.

error.type.about: How a call failed: tool_error, a JSON-RPC or HTTP code, how a connection failed, a PLexus error code, or an exception class of Pharo, MCP or Node.

plexus.client.name.about: The agent host, as it introduces itself to PLexus's server, when it is one the allowlist knows.

plexus.client.version.about: The agent host's version, major and minor, beside a name the allowlist knows.

plexus.call.index.about: Where the call comes in its session: 1 for the first.

plexus.call.forwarded.about: Whether PLexus passed the call on to an image, which then names the tool.

plexus.argument.names.about: The names of the arguments a call to one of PLexus's own tools gave, never their values.

plexus.argument.unknown_names.about: Argument names a call gave that PLexus's own tool does not take.

plexus.error.code.about: Why PLexus refused a call before any image saw it.

plexus.image.save.about: Whether stopping an image saved it.

pharo.mcp.tool.origin.about: mcp for one of MCP's own tools, other for a tool another package added, unknown for a name no tool has. Names are kept for mcp and unknown, and for a tool a project publishes.

pharo.mcp.dispatch_path.about: How the image dispatched the request.

pharo.mcp.client.name.about: The agent host, as it introduces itself to MCP's server, when it is one the allowlist knows: under PLexus, PLexus itself.

pharo.mcp.client.version.about: Its version, major and minor, beside a name the allowlist knows.

pharo.mcp.argument.names.about: The names of the arguments the tool declares that the call gave, never their values.

pharo.mcp.argument.unknown_names.about: Argument names the call gave that the tool does not declare.

pharo.mcp.argument.options.about: The options the call chose, as the evaluations count them: a property, a value of an enumeration, or a list given for several targets.

pharo.mcp.output_budget.exceeded.about: Whether the answer was cut to fit the output budget, which its size, kept in buckets, does not say.

pharo.mcp.result.count.about: How many results a search answered.

pharo.mcp.result.more.about: Whether there were more results than answered.

pharo.mcp.tool.refs.about: The tools a discovery call (tool_search, tool_get) named.

pharo.mcp.error.kind.about: The kind of error MCP reported.

pharo.mcp.error.code.about: The error code MCP gave its answer.

pharo.mcp.error.schema.violation_count.about: How many times the arguments broke the tool's input schema, where the rules and places they broke are each named once.

pharo.mcp.error.schema.paths.about: Where in the tool's input they broke them.

pharo.mcp.exception.type.about: The nearest Pharo or MCP class of an exception.

span.duration_ms.about: How long the span took, in whole milliseconds, kept since its times are not.

pharo_agent_telemetry.session.offset_ms.about: When the span started, in milliseconds after the first span of its session the agent on your machine saw (negative when it saw a later one first): the order of a session's calls, never a time of day.
